Dear Ms. Chen,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding your account with us, we acknowledge your claim of hardship. We understand that you are disputing the balance of $2,896.26 on your account with Lakeshore Utilities, which was originally charged off on August 22, 2020.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Kentucky state law, we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account history to determine the accuracy of the balance and the status of your payments. We will also verify the charge-off date and the last payment date of March 22, 2021.

We will investigate your claim that you returned the items and were current on payments at that time. However, we must inform you that we do not have any record of a return or a request for a return in our files. We will also look into the matter of the alleged harassment and the calls you received regarding the balance.

Please be advised that we will provide you with a written validation of the debt if our investigation confirms the accuracy of the balance. If our investigation reveals that the balance is incorrect, we will take the necessary steps to correct the account.

You have the right to dispute this debt and may request a written verification of the debt, which we will provide upon request. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

Pinnacle Asset Management
